hook: In pooled lending, bad debt from a single defaulted asset spreads across every participant sharing the pool.
body: When debt mutualizes, an insolvency in one collateral type reduces the backing for unrelated balances. Structural isolation prevents this by keeping position balances segregated; a shortfall remains bounded to the specific position rather than migrating across the protocol. Across Stellar Soroban, Blend TVL stands at $157,161,882 while Soroswap TVL is $1,238,140, on a ledger operating at 0.08 capacity usage and a base fee of 100. Isolation does not remove market risk, but it restricts the boundary of failure.
